facts.content: Patient has chest discomfort.
facts.source_text: CC: Chest discomfort

facts.content: Patient experienced sudden onset of mid-chest pressure lasting for a few hours while gardening.
facts.source_text: Sudden onset mid‑chest pressure “like someone sitting on my chest” x few hrs; occurred while gardening

facts.content: The chest pain severity is rated 7/10 and is persistent and unchanged.
facts.source_text: Severity 7/10; persistent, unchanged

facts.content: The chest pain radiates to the left shoulder and arm.
facts.source_text: Radiation: left shoulder/arm; no radiation to back/head

facts.content: Associated symptoms include shortness of breath, light-headedness, and nausea.
facts.source_text: Assoc: SOB, light‑headedness, nausea (no vomiting)

facts.content: No dysphagia or urinary/bowel issues.
facts.source_text: No dysphagia; no urinary/bowel issues

facts.content: Patient has experienced recent decreased exercise tolerance and shortness of breath on stairs or uphill.
facts.source_text: Recent ↓ exercise tolerance: SOB on stairs/uphill

facts.content: Patient reports intermittent calf pain and leg swelling.
facts.source_text: Intermittent calf pain and leg swelling

facts.content: Patient has a history of hypertension.
facts.source_text: PMH: HTN

facts.content: Patient has a history of hypercholesterolemia.
facts.source_text: PMH: hypercholesterolemia

facts.content: Patient is not taking any medications.
facts.source_text: Meds: none

facts.content: Patient is a current smoker and lives with his wife.
facts.source_text: SH: Current smoker; lives with wife

facts.content: Due to shortness of breath, the patient limits activities of daily living to around the house.
facts.source_text: limits ADLs to around house due to SOB

facts.content: High concern for ACS/unstable angina due to acute chest pressure with shortness of breath, nausea, and left arm radiation.
facts.source_text: Acute chest pressure with SOB, nausea, and L arm radiation — high concern for ACS/unstable angina

facts.content: Risk factors include hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and smoking.
facts.source_text: RFs: HTN, HLD, smoker

facts.content: Exertional dyspnea with reports of leg swelling and calf pain may indicate a cardiac etiology.
facts.source_text: Exertional dyspnea; reports leg swelling/calf pain — consider cardiac etiology; further eval needed

facts.content: Light-headedness is likely related to the above conditions.
facts.source_text: Light‑headedness — likely related to above

facts.content: Call emergency ambulance to the emergency department for urgent ACS rule-out, including ECG, serial troponins, vitals, CXR, and labs.
facts.source_text: Call emergency ambulance to ED for urgent ACS rule‑out (ECG, serial troponins, vitals, CXR, labs)

facts.content: Advise rest, stay calm, avoid exertion; small sips of water if needed; avoid taking any meds as advised.
facts.source_text: Advise rest; stay calm; avoid exertion; small sips of water if needed; avoid taking any meds as advised

facts.content: Provide handover information to paramedics regarding symptoms, risk factors, and lack of medications.
facts.source_text: Provide handover info to paramedics re: symptoms, RFs, lack of meds

facts.content: Patient to inform wife and prepare for hospital transfer.
facts.source_text: Patient to inform wife and prepare for hospital transfer

facts.content: Arrange follow-up after hospital evaluation.
facts.source_text: Arrange follow‑up after hospital evaluation
